MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

2. When learning Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.

3. When learning Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.

4. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Information and Communication Technology

6. When learning Pre - Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre - Production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre - Production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Pre - Production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre - Production.

7. When learning Introduction to Media Technology, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Media Technology.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Media Technology.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Media Technology.

8. When learning Digital Video Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production.

9. When learning Photography, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Photography.

10. When learning Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

12. When learning Audio Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Audio Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Media Ownership and Management Page 15 of 40 1 STRAND 1.0 FUNDAMENTALS OF MEDIA  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Media Ownership and Management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
